Ingredients:
<style="highlight">Three portions of glacier grass</style>.

Crush the glacier grass, add purified water, and boil. Filter the liquid seven times or use magic to remove toxins, then let it cool before consumption.

冰轮药水
配料：
<style="highlight">3份冰轮草</style>
将冰轮草碾碎，加纯水熬煮，液体过滤七次或用魔法去除其中毒性，放凉后服用
